market.note: FantasyCalc accepts only dynasty/numQbs/numTeams/ppr. TE premium and points per first down cannot be requested, so each position is corrected by how far this league's real scoring lifts it relative to the rest, measured over every completed season.

note: Points are what each side has scored SINCE the trade: players received, plus the players actually drafted with picks received. Assets traded on again count toward that later trade, not this one.
